current_role: Chair of the Open Society Foundations (since December 2022); head of the Soros family's political operation
summary: Alex Soros, a son of George Soros, chairs the Open Society Foundations and since 2023 has run the family's charitable and political activities, including Democracy PAC, one of the largest Democratic funders. He married Huma Abedin, Hillary Clinton's longtime aide, in June 2025 at a wedding attended by the Clintons, Kamala Harris, Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer.
